communication_goal: 提炼一次技术学习，并用具体过程说明可复用方法。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure colleagues have an informal learning conversation at a small round table. The developer on the left opens a large paper notebook toward the teammate on the right and gestures to its pages. The notebook lies flat at the center foreground, with two clearly visible blank ruled pages and spiral binding; one small pen beside it. The teammate leans in attentively with an open hand. Keep the entire notebook unobstructed, with hands beside it rather than over the pages. No text, lettering, numbers, code, or speech bubbles.

image_review.summary: 通过：同事在圆桌旁讨论排查经验，前景双页螺旋笔记本完整可见，一人指向页内。记录方法和经验教训由对白说明；仅框纸质笔记本，不把静态手势或空白笔记本当学习成果证明。
